decision_conditions: <p>All conditions under 20/P1738, other than condition 2 and 4 attached to this permission, remain applicable and shall be discharged as relevant in accordance with the decision notice for planning permission 20/P1738.</p><p>Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.</p>

<p>Phase 1 (Plant/Machinery Noise) - In accordance with permission&nbsp;25/P2381 Noise levels, (expressed as the equivalent continuous sound level) LAeq (15 minutes), from the new plant/machinery within Phase 1 shall not exceed LA90-5dB at the boundary with any residential property on South Park Road. All mitigation measures outlined in the Andersons Acoustics Report (Ref: 5962_003M_1-0_JE, dated 18 March 2025) - including the upgraded acoustic enclosure and 1.8m high acoustic fence - shall be implemented in full within 3 months of this planning permission date and maintained thereafter.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenities of surrounding area and to ensure compliance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: P15.10 of Merton's Local Plan 2024.</p>
description: APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 (APPROVED PLANS), ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING APPLICATION 20/P1738 RELATING TO THE DEMOLITION OF BUILDINGS AND A 2 PHASED REDEVELOPMENT COMPRISING A MIXED USE DEVELOPMENT WITH THE ERECTION OF PART BASEMENT, PART SINGLE, PART FIVE, PART 6, PART 7, PART 8 AND PART 9 STOREY BUILDINGS. PHASE 1 COMPRISING DEMOLITION OF OLYMPIC HOUSE AND PART OF YMCA AND ERECTION OF A 121 ROOM HOMELESS HOSTEL (SUI GENERIS) WITH ANCILLARY GYM AND CAFE PHASE 2 COMPRISING DEMOLITION OF REMAINDER OF SITE AND ERECTION OF 135 FLATS AND 333SQM OF FLEXIBLE CLASS A1 (EXCLUDING SUPERMARKETS) /A2/A3/B1(A)/D1 FLOOR SPACE WITH VEHICLE ACCESS FROM TRINITY ROAD, ANCILLARY CAR AND CYCLE PARKING, LANDSCAPING AND ASSOCIATED WORKS.CHANGES RELATE TO THE AMALGAMATION OF 3 X 1-BED UNITS AND 1 X 2-BED UNIT INTO 1 X 4-BED UNIT.
